dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Hmm... Are you interested in finches? I think they sing very beautifully.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: And I can sing too, by the way, hehe!

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Yeah! In the past, while my parents busied themselves planting herbs, I would often run off into the hills and forests to play...

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: And there was one time I encountered a large finch teaching a smaller finch how to sing.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: The big finch would sing a line, the small finch would follow along, and so would I. ♪ *whistle*~ ♪

choices.text: You should come over to play more often in future!

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Sure, can't say no to that!

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: And to thank you for "taking me under your wing," allow me to teach you the song of the finches.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Don't worry, it's waaaay easier than learning to use a spear!

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Oh, don't worry, Master taught me this thing called... ah, "understanding by analogy"!

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: I want you to see this as just us having some fun, not studying a difficult class or anything.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: So let's do it like this: I'll sing a line, and you'll follow after me.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Don't sweat the other stuff. I'll make the arrangements!

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Isn't it? This is what they call, um, "finding joy in the little things"!

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: And I wanna share this little bit of joy with you.
